answer: Proof-of-burn rate-limiting resists Sybil attacks by forcing agents to verifiably destroy capital for temporary access. To participate in a consensus summit, each agent burns tokens against a stepped mesa pricing curve to generate an operational ember that decays over fixed epochs. An attacker incurs the verifiable, non-recoverable monetary cost of burning liquid assets per pseudonymous identity. However, well-funded adversaries can still dominate admission by absorbing high financial losses.
